concept.anti_generic_signature: The castle is not decoration: it is solid material rooted through the lower moon lip inside the fully penetrating crescent window.
assumptions: A broad-face FDM orientation is available within a common 220 x 220 mm build area.

components.form: Constant-depth planar extrusion with a profiled rocking perimeter and fully penetrating crescent window.
components.interfaces: Long lower dragon rest facet, diagonal castle rest facet, and the user's fingertip during the rock.
components.name: Mooncoil Dragon one-piece body
components.placement: Entire product envelope, with the castle materially rooted through the lower moon lip.
components.purpose: Provide both stable rests and both readable silhouettes in one printable solid.

concept.hardest_to_fake_magic: A single held silhouette settles as a sleeping dragon, then one gravity-driven rock makes its bright internal void stand upright as a crescent carrying a castle.
concept.intended_interaction: Set the talisman on its long dragon facet, then tip it clockwise across the curved cam until it settles on the diagonal castle facet.
concept.signature_decision: Use one constant-depth silhouette with two deliberate resting facets, making the pose change itself rotate the visual hierarchy from dragon landmarks to the crescent-and-castle void.
concept.signature_interaction: Rock the thick planar talisman between two engineered edge facets; the first pose foregrounds tucked snout, horn, wing and tail, while the second makes the crescent-and-castle aperture plumb.
concept.summary: A palm-sized one-piece rocker whose first rest reads as a curled sleeping dragon and whose second rest turns a fully penetrating void into a bright crescent carrying a tiny castle.
concept.title: Mooncoil Dragon
unresolved_risks: Digital checks do not establish real-world rocking stability, print success, durability, or across-room human recognition.

research.fabrication: Constant-depth planar extrusion prints on its broad face; all openings run vertically in the print stance, requiring no support.
research.limits: Digital geometry checks do not prove a successful physical print or real-world rocking behavior.
research.selection: The two-flat silhouette cam preserves the organic outline and supplies two explicit energy minima without parts.
